properties.description: At every eligible pre/post observation, occupancy equals the independent queue count. Acceptance uses pre-edge queue occupancy, rejecting writes at full and reads at empty even during simultaneous requests.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independent queue contains 16 words.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independent queue contains zero words.

When the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals the oldest accepted word. Checks ordering, retention, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, and post-reset operation; empty data is unconstrained.
Observed occupancy is known and within the legal range zero through 16.
After each synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is deasserted, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation.
